hero.headline: One platform. Every tool your business needs.
hero.subhead: Certxa covers the full day at your business — from the first online booking to end-of-day close, payroll, client notifications, waitlist management, and review management. Built for nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, massage studios, hair removal studios, and braid and weave salons.

sections.headline: Clients book online, around the clock.

body.text: Give every client a booking page where they pick their service, provider, and time — from any device, any time of day. Clients can book directly from your website, a direct link, Google, or Instagram. Service-specific options like nail length, shape, and design are available for nail salons.

Automated text and email reminders go out before every appointment, and instant confirmations are sent the moment a booking is made. Clients can reschedule from the same confirmation link without calling.

bullets.text: Service, provider, and time selection
Service-specific options at booking (e.g. nail length, shape, and design)
Book from your website, Google, or Instagram
Automated text and email reminders
Instant booking confirmations
Client self-service rescheduling

sections.headline: Every team member's day, at a glance.

body.text: A live multi-staff calendar gives your whole team instant visibility of every appointment, break, and booking gap. Appointments are color-coded by team member so the front desk can see the full picture in seconds.
Drag and drop to move appointments, block time for breaks and holidays, and print a daily run sheet in one click. Walk-ins appear alongside bookings so nothing falls through the cracks.

bullets.text: Live multi-staff calendar view
Color-coded by team member
Drag-and-drop rescheduling
Block time for breaks and holidays
Printable daily run sheets
Walk-ins alongside bookings

body.text: A tablet at the front door lets clients check in with their phone number or a QR code, choose their service, and join the queue without waiting for staff. Service-specific options — like nail length and shape for nail salons, or treatment type for spas and massage studios — are presented at check-in.
The kiosk recognizes returning clients and suggests what they are due for based on their visit history. It prints a check-in slip and works in English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese, and Korean.

bullets.text: Check in by phone number or QR code
Returning client recognition and service suggestions
Service-specific options at check-in
Joins queue and prints check-in slip
English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese, and Korean

body.text: A touch-screen POS handles tickets, services, add-ons, discounts, tips, and split payments — all synced instantly to every client record. Accept card payments with a card reader, cash, and gift cards.
Print receipts, open the cash drawer, and close the day with a cash count and printed report. Works across multiple front desk stations and keeps running when the internet goes down.

Split payments and gift card redemption
Tipping prompts on every transaction
Next-day payouts to your bank
Syncs to client profiles automatically
Receipt printing and cash drawer
Multi-station support
Offline mode — saves tickets when internet is down

body.text: When your business is fully booked, Certxa captures walk-ins on a live digital waitlist. The moment a slot opens up, the next client is automatically notified and given a simple confirmation window — so you fill cancellations instantly without any manual follow-up.
Clients on the waitlist can see their estimated wait time, and loyalty members can be given priority. Every walk-in is captured, every slot is filled.

bullets.text: Live digital waitlist for walk-ins
Auto-text when a slot opens
One-tap client confirmation
Priority bumping for loyalty members
Estimated wait time display

sections.headline: The right message, at the right moment.

body.text: Certxa handles every client communication automatically — booking confirmations, appointment reminders, rescheduling alerts, waitlist notifications, and post-visit review requests. Clients always know where they stand without your staff making a single call.
When a client is overdue for their next visit, Certxa sends a personalized re-engagement text at exactly the right time — based on their own visit history, not a generic schedule.

Rescheduling and cancellation alerts
Waitlist slot-open notifications
Post-visit review request texts
Personalized re-engagement texts for overdue clients

body.text: Certxa assigns walk-ins to staff members automatically based on rules the business sets. The turn board shows who is next, who is with a client, and who is on a break — keeping things fair and transparent for the whole team.

bullets.text: Automatic turn assignment for walk-ins
Business-set rotation rules
Live view of next, busy, and on-break status

sections.headline: Pay your team accurately, every time.

body.text: Set commission rates per staff member and track tips separately. Add recurring deductions the owner sets, run pay periods, and print earnings statements and paychecks.
Every paycheck includes a breakdown of exactly which tickets earned each commission, so there are no disputes and no guesswork.

sections.headline: Two loyalty programs. One happy client base.

body.text: Choose the program that fits your business. The digital punch card awards one punch per visit — once a client reaches the number you set, a reward is automatically applied at checkout. No paper cards, no manual tracking.

Prefer a points-based program? Clients earn points for every dollar they spend. You set the rewards — a dollar-off discount, a free add-on, whatever works for your business. Every client also has a full profile with visit history and preferences, and you can send targeted text campaigns to bring people back during slow periods.

Points program — clients earn points per dollar spent

sections.headline: Know exactly where your revenue is going.

body.text: Certxa monitors your booking data continuously and surfaces the revenue opportunities your team would otherwise miss. When a client drifts past their usual visit cadence, a personalized re-engagement text goes out automatically — no manual follow-up needed.

See which time slots are consistently underbooked, which staff members have the highest rebooking rates, and which clients are at risk of churning — all in one place. A monthly revenue leakage report shows exactly which lapsed clients represent lost income, with a one-tap option to reach them.

body.text: After every visit, Certxa automatically texts the client asking for a review, with a link straight to your Google review page. Every client gets the same link, so your reviews reflect every visit.
See all your Google reviews in one place, get alerts for new ones, reply from inside Certxa, and keep your Google Business Profile up to date — including your booking link.

bullets.text: Automatic post-visit review request by text
Happy clients directed to Google review page
One review link for every client, as Google requires
All Google reviews in one place with alerts
Reply to reviews from inside Certxa
Google Business Profile kept up to date

body.text: Autumn answers every call within two seconds — booking new appointments, handling rescheduling and cancellations, answering questions about services and pricing, and upselling add-ons. All without you lifting a finger.

While your salon is open, Autumn sees your live board: who is clocked in, who is with a client, and how many people are waiting. She gives callers a real wait time — not a guess. After hours, she keeps booking and answering questions without implying anyone is in the building.
